classification.difficultyReason: Requires interpreting the dissections, choosing triangle areas or subtraction from larger regions, and connecting relative areas to fractions and percentages; the table scaffolds recording but not the geometric strategy.

content.prompt: Each square has been dissected into pieces. Express each piece as a fraction and percentage of the whole. Check that the fractions for each square sum to $1$.

spec.description: Unshaded square dissected into six regions A–F, retaining the central vertical, lower-left inset square and both right-side diagonals.
spec.mathematics: Unit-square regions have areas A=1/4, B=1/16, C=3/16, D=5/16, E=1/16 and F=1/8.
spec.answerVisibility: Piece labels and subdivision lines are permanent givens; no fractions or percentages appear in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Take the whole square to have area $1$. Use the square subdivisions and half the base times height for the triangles.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12\times\frac12=\frac14\\B&=\frac14\times\frac14=\frac1{16}\\C&=\frac14-\frac1{16}=\frac3{16}\\E&=\frac12\times\frac14\times\frac12=\frac1{16}\\F&=\frac12\times\frac12\times\frac12=\frac18\\D&=\frac12-\frac1{16}-\frac18=\frac5{16}\end{align*}$$
Multiply each fraction by $100\%$:
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac14\times100\%=25\%\\B&=\frac1{16}\times100\%=6.25\%\\C&=\frac3{16}\times100\%=18.75\%\\D&=\frac5{16}\times100\%=31.25\%\\E&=\frac1{16}\times100\%=6.25\%\\F&=\frac18\times100\%=12.5\%\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Seven unshaded regions A–G on a dot grid with ten equal intervals along each side. White label masks preserve readability without filling regions.
spec.mathematics: Unit-square regions have areas A=1/4, B=1/8, C=3/8, D=1/8, E=1/16, F=1/32 and G=1/32.
spec.answerVisibility: Dots, region boundaries and piece labels are permanent givens; answers are absent.

answer.worked:
Take the whole square to have area $1$. The dot grid shows the relative lengths. Use half the base times height for each triangle; C is the remaining region above the main diagonal.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12\times1\times\frac12=\frac14\\B&=\frac12\times\frac12\times\frac12=\frac18\\C&=\frac12-\frac18=\frac38\\D&=\frac12\times\frac12\times\frac12=\frac18\\E&=\frac12\times\frac12\times\frac14=\frac1{16}\\F&=\frac12\times\frac14\times\frac14=\frac1{32}\\G&=\frac12\times\frac14\times\frac14=\frac1{32}\end{align*}$$
Multiply each fraction by $100\%$:
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac14\times100\%=25\%\\B&=\frac18\times100\%=12.5\%\\C&=\frac38\times100\%=37.5\%\\D&=\frac18\times100\%=12.5\%\\E&=\frac1{16}\times100\%=6.25\%\\F&=\frac1{32}\times100\%=3.125\%\\G&=\frac1{32}\times100\%=3.125\%\end{align*}$$
